```{r}
## create cleaned variables 
## get years from 65, keep only positive weights cos 0 weights doesnt add to the analysis, get health status that are relevant, indicator for poor health, indicator for very good health, indicator for low education 
## Create analysis variables while retaining original columns
df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # Distance from the eligibility cutoff, in years
    age_c = age4 - 65,

    # Medicare eligibility
    eligible65 = as.integer(age4 >= 65),

    # Flag usable weights; this does NOT remove observations
    positive_weight = !is.na(wt) & wt > 0,

    # Valid self-rated health categories
    health_clean = if_else(
      health %in% 1:5,
      as.numeric(health),
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Correct poor-health indicator
    poor_clean = if_else(
      is.na(health_clean),
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(health_clean == 5)
    ),

    # Below high-school education; preserve missing education
    lowed_clean = if_else(
      is.na(educ),
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(educ < 12)
    ),

    # Categorical versions for later analysis
    region_factor = factor(region),
    year_factor = factor(year)
  )
```

```{r}
key_vars <- c(
  "age4", "eligible65",
  "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor_clean",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean", "region",
  "year", "wt", "emp"
)

missing_table <- df %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(key_vars), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_missing = round(100 * n_missing / nrow(df), 2)
  )

print(missing_table)
```
```{r}
## df using only the key variables and dropped na

df_select <- df %>%
  select(all_of(key_vars)) %>%
  drop_na()
head(df_select)
```


```{r}
## prepare data for eda
eda <- df %>%
  filter(positive_weight) %>% ## positive weights
  mutate(
    side = factor(
      if_else(age4 < 65, "Below 65", "65 and above"), ## indicator for below 65 and above 65 
      levels = c("Below 65", "65 and above")
    ),

    # Region shares: do not average numeric region codes
    region1 = as.integer(region == 1),
    region2 = as.integer(region == 2),
    region3 = as.integer(region == 3),
    region4 = as.integer(region == 4)
  )
```


```{r}
## descriptive table for ages 60-70 
## Summarise coverage, outcomes and characteristics on each side.
summary_vars <- c(
  "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor_clean",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean",
  "region1", "region2", "region3", "region4",
  "emp"
)

descriptive_table <- eda %>%
  filter(between(age4, 60, 70)) %>%
  select(side, wt, all_of(summary_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(summary_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(variable, side) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observed = n(),
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(value, wt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

descriptive_table
```

```{r}
### plot coverage, utilisation, health against age 
#### calculate weighted means at each observed quarter-year age:
profile_vars <- c(
  "mcare", "covered2",
  "sawdr", "inhosp",
  "goodplus", "poor_clean",
  "female", "wnh", "bnh", "hispanic", "onh",
  "educ", "lowed_clean",
  "region1", "region2", "region3", "region4",
  "emp"
)

age_profiles <- eda %>%
  select(age4, side, wt, all_of(profile_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(profile_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(age4, side, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observed = n(),
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(value, wt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

profile_labels <- c(
  mcare = "Medicare coverage",
  covered2 = "Any insurance",
  sawdr = "Doctor visit in past year",
  inhosp = "Overnight hospital stay",
  goodplus = "Good or better health",
  poor_clean = "Poor health",
  female = "Female",
  wnh = "White non-Hispanic",
  bnh = "Black non-Hispanic",
  hispanic = "Hispanic",
  onh = "Other non-Hispanic",
  educ = "Years of education",
  lowed_clean = "Below high school",
  region1 = "Region 1",
  region2 = "Region 2",
  region3 = "Region 3",
  region4 = "Region 4",
  emp = "Employed"
)

plot_profiles <- function(vars, title, percentage = TRUE) {

  plot_data <- age_profiles %>%
    filter(
      variable %in% vars,
      between(age4, 60, 70)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_value = weighted_mean *
        if (percentage) 100 else 1
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = age4,
      y = plot_value,
      colour = side,
      group = side
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 65,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey40"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ variable,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = as_labeller(profile_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Age in years",
      y = if (percentage) {
        "Survey-weighted percentage"
      } else {
        "Survey-weighted mean"
      },
      colour = NULL,
      caption = paste(
        "Quarter-year age cells; variable-specific available samples.",
        "Lines connect observed means separately on each side of 65."
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
# Insurance coverage
p_coverage <- plot_profiles(
  c("mcare", "covered2"),
  "Insurance coverage around age 65"
)
p_coverage

# Healthcare utilisation
p_utilisation <- plot_profiles(
  c("sawdr", "inhosp"),
  "Healthcare utilisation around age 65"
)
p_utilisation

# Exploratory health outcomes
p_health <- plot_profiles(
  c("goodplus", "poor_clean"),
  "Self-rated health around age 65"
)
p_health
```

```{r}
#### missingness check by year 
missing_by_year <- df %>%
  select(year, mcare, covered2, sawdr, inhosp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mcare, covered2, sawdr, inhosp),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    missing_pct = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(missing_by_year, aes(year, missing_pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Missing information by survey year",
    x = "Survey year",
    y = "Missing observations (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## missingness near cutoff 
missing_by_age <- df %>%
  select(age4, mcare, covered2, sawdr, inhosp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mcare, covered2, sawdr, inhosp),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(age4, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    missing_pct = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  filter(missing_by_age, between(age4, 60, 70)),
  aes(age4, missing_pct)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(group = age4 >= 65)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Missing information around age 65",
    x = "Age in years",
    y = "Missing observations (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## how many respondents in each age cell 
df %>%
  count(age4) %>%
  ggplot(aes(age4, n)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.20, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Sample size by quarter-year age",
    x = "Age in years",
    y = "Number of respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
### comparing utilisation across survey periods 
period_profiles <- eda %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      year <= 1996 ~ "1992–1996",
      year <= 1999 ~ "1997–1999",
      TRUE ~ "2000–2003"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(age4, side, period, wt, sawdr, inhosp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sawdr, inhosp),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), between(age4, 60, 70)) %>%
  group_by(period, variable, age4, side) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_pct = 100 * weighted.mean(value, wt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  period_profiles,
  aes(age4, weighted_pct, colour = side, group = side)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(variable ~ period, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Utilisation profiles across survey periods",
    x = "Age in years",
    y = "Survey-weighted percentage",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
outcome_vars <- c(
  "sawdr", "inhosp", "goodplus", "poor_clean"
)

sample_sizes <- df %>%
  select(age4, positive_weight, all_of(outcome_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(outcome_vars),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    master_n = n(),

    outcome_observed_n = sum(!is.na(value)),

    observed_positive_weight_n = sum(
      !is.na(value) & positive_weight
    ),

    observed_positive_weight_ages60_70_n = sum(
      !is.na(value) &
        positive_weight &
        between(age4, 60, 70)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(sample_sizes)

write.csv(
  sample_sizes,
  "outputs/outcome_sample_sizes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
